name.fr-FR: Lettres de saint François de Sales, tome XVI
name.en-US: Letters of St. Francis de Sales, vol. XVI
name.pt-BR: Cartas de São Francisco de Sales, tomo XVI

description.fr-FR: Les lettres de saint François de Sales du tome XVI de l’édition d’Annecy (1613-1614), une lettre par chapitre, groupées par année : numéro, destinataire, résumé et date de l’édition critique, puis le texte en orthographe d’époque.
description.en-US: The letters of St. Francis de Sales in volume XVI of the Annecy edition (1613-1614), one letter per chapter and grouped by year: the edition’s number, addressee, summary and date, then the text in period spelling.
description.pt-BR: As cartas de São Francisco de Sales do tomo XVI da edição de Annecy (1613-1614).

sources.edition: Œuvres de saint François de Sales, édition d’Annecy, tome XVI (Lettres), Annecy: J. Niérat, 1900-1923; digital transcription in original spelling by JesusMarie.com.
sources.description: The editors’ letter numbers, addressee headings, summaries and dates are kept; footnotes, variants, the glossary, the indexes and the appendix of letters addressed to Francis are not included.
sources.tierEvidence: Francis died in 1622; the Annecy edition appeared in 1900-1923, before 1930. The JesusMarie transcription is of his own text with the edition’s headings.
